description: Stream Live IPTV, Video On-Demand, and Series from an Xtream-compatible server using this plugin.
name: Jellyfin Xtream
overview: Stream content from an Xtream-compatible server.

versions.changelog:
- Fix dynamic channels not being favorited on Jellyfin 12 (MissingMethodException on IUserManager.Users)
- Plugin now targets Jellyfin 12.4 / .NET 10

Dynamic channels improvements:
- Rules are shown in a table with categories and a live match count (click to list the channels)
- Searchable multi-select dropdown for choosing categories
- Matched channels can be automatically marked as favorite for all users after each guide refresh
Adds a Dynamic channels tab: keyword rules that automatically add (and later remove) Live TV channels from selected categories on each guide refresh.
